授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Calculus, first introduced by Newton and Leibniz in the seventeenth century, is one of the
cornerstones of modern mathematics. It finds application in all areas of science and
engineering and beyond. The present course continues from Calculus I and II to conclude
consideration of functions that depend on a single variable, and then proceeds to
consider the calculus of functions of many variables, considering their limits, continuity,
derivatives and integration. Along the way we will consider applications that include
determining the extreme values of mulitvariable functions such as the maximum/minimum
temperatures of a heated object, the calculation of volumes of arbitrary three-dimensional
objects and their centres of mass.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: multivariable functions, partial differentiation, extreme values, multiple integration
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
Calculus I, II
This course assumes understanding of the basic calculus concepts that are studied in Calculus I and II. Furthermore, the concepts developed in this course build directly on those developed  in Calculus I and II.
*For these reasons it is expected that you have passed both Calculus I and II before
enrolling in this course.*
If you have not passed Calculus I and Calculus II, but still wish to take Calculus III then please
contact WALL (
wall@aero.kyushu-u.ac.jp
) before the course commences.
